messages:
Alice Nguyen: Quick signal — EU recompute backfills are drifting; slot fragmentation on eu-west-1 where tenant-acme holds ~40% of active slots, causing 2x tail latency. cc @Ben
Ben Patel: which queue? replay-high or compute?
Alice Nguyen: replay-high. See sample from infra-bot below
infra-bot: job 0x9f3 started shard=eu-west-1 slot=421 tenant=tenant-acme allocated=12/30
Carla Ortiz: is this the same as the 'stitch' fragmentation we saw in Feb? Could be priority weight skew.
Dan Morris: propose temporary drain: per-tenant soft-cap then round-robin refill. Can we add a 'drain_until' window to the backfill API?
Emma Li: UI would be nice — a slider for per-run weight/priority. But SRE needs API first.
Frank Müller: API change is small: POST /api/backfills/{id}/actions {"drain_till":"2024-11-12T03:00Z","max_slots":6} — quick patch, I can prototype.
Ben Patel: +1. Concern: quota accounting when we forcibly drain — need to subtract from tenant budget so they don't overspend.
Alice Nguyen: agreed. Policy idea: drained runs consume 'reserve' quota, otherwise throttle. Also add telemetry counters: 'drain_events' and 'slot_shift'.
Carla Ortiz: add UI flag 'paused_for_tenant_balance' with tooltip explaining cost/latency tradeoff.
Dan Morris: SRE plan: run a canary on 3 tenants for 1 hour, monitor agg-lag and slot-imbalance. I'll spin it up. infra-bot: create canary job?
infra-bot: canary 0xdef created; targets: tenant-acme, tenant-phi, tenant-beta; watches: agg-lag, slot-imbalance
Emma Li: also add logs to /observability/backfills with tag "drain_action=true" and a metric for 'drain_recovery_seconds'
Frank Müller: opening PR for API + console mockups. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Ben Patel: add rollback path if SLOs regress. @Dan please have runbooks ready.
Alice Nguyen: Assigning myself to canary monitors. I'll triage if it breaks. :thumbsup:
